node.text: So it does. I know my own hand.
That is my mark. I remember the work, if not the day.
Mine, yes. It has been further than I have.
I made that. Keep it in better repair than the last one I saw.

choice.text: It is good work, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
It has served me well.
I thought you would want to know.
I am =name=.~ My name is =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.~ You may call me =name=.~ I am called =name=. Now you know it.~ =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. That is my name.

node.text: =name=. I will remember it.~ Then I know you, =name=.~ =name=. The name is heard.~ Well met, =name=.~ I have it, =name=.
node.choice: Good.~Then we understand each other.~As it should be.

choice.text: Do you know me by now?~ Am I a familiar face here?~ You have seen me before, I think.~ Do you remember my face, or only my water?~ Do you know me, or just my trade?

node.text: I know the faces that come back, and yours is one. That is most of what trade is, out here.~ I remember the ones who return. Out here that is worth more than a good haggle.~ Your face, your water, and what you last carried off. A trader keeps all three.~ You I know. Half my custom I never see twice - that is the salt for you.~ Well enough. A stranger is a price; somebody who comes back is a living.

choice.text: Good.~That is worth something.~Then we understand each other.
We shared water once.~ Water passed between us, you and I.~ You drank with me, once.~ There was water between us.~ Do you remember the water we shared?

node.text: I remember it. Since that day I have heard =Vixy_ritualreport= of you among my people.~ The water is not forgotten. Since then there has come =Vixy_ritualreport= of you.~ I remember. My people have spoken =Vixy_ritualreport= of you since.~ That water still stands between us. Since then there has been =Vixy_ritualreport= of you.~ I remember the water. And I have heard =Vixy_ritualreport= of you since.

choice.text: You have the trick of a sharp edge. There is a finer one past it.

node.text: Sharp is where an edge starts. Hold it to the light and grind past the shine - that is keen. Your hands will know when.

choice.text: Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
How do you fare, master?~ How is the work?~ Are you well?~ And you - how do you find the years?

node.text: I am old, child, and the work is longer than I am. That was true before you came. It is less heavy said aloud to someone who comes back.~ The work is well. I have set a thing down and picked it up again more times than you have been alive - and lately I set it down when you arrive, which is new.~ Well enough. I have outlasted my own certainties and most of my friends. You are neither, yet.~ The years are a material like any other, =name=. They yield if you are patient. I have been very patient.

choice.text: Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.~I'll come back.~That is worth hearing.
Master, teach me to make something that outlasts me.

node.text: Masterwork is a thing made well. Legendary is a thing made once. The difference is not in the steel, child - it is in refusing to set it down.

choice.text: Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
Your teeth are finer than my saw. Show me.

node.text: Serration is teeth. Microserration is teeth on the teeth. Cut smaller, cut smaller, cut smaller - and then the flesh simply agrees to part.

choice.text: Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
How's the work?~ How do you fare?~ Building anything good?~ And you - how are you keeping?

node.text: Good! Loud, mostly. I have three things half-built and one of them is arguing with me. Come back and I'll show you which.~ Keeping? I keep forgetting to. But you turn up and ask, and then I remember I have a body. That's useful, actually.~ Something is always building. The interesting question is whether it agrees. Ask me again in a week, =name=, the answer changes.~ Well! Better than the regulator, worse than the cell. Somewhere in there.

choice.text: I'll come back.~I'd like to see it.~Good.
How far past its rating can a cell actually be pushed?

node.text: Further than the plate says. The plate is a promise to a customer, not a limit. Wind the regulator past its stop and hold your breath - it draws far more, and it will tell you when it disagrees.

choice.text: Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
How does the trade find you, Tam?~ How do you fare, Tam?~ Is it well with you, Tam?~ And you - how are your days here?

node.text: It is not the trade, =name=. It is that you return, and the returning is the thing. My people count a road by those who walk it twice.~ Well enough, =name=, and better for the asking. The salt teaches us to mark who comes back.~ We are settled, and settled is strange to me still. But a face I know twice makes a place feel less like a stop.~ My chests are heavy and my legs are idle, =name=. It is a good trade. Ask me again in a season.~ I am far from Moghra'yi and not sorry for it. You are the second thing here I did not have to learn twice.

choice.text: How are you keeping, Elder?~ And how is it with you, Elder?~ How do you fare, Elder?~ Is there ease with you today?

node.text: -mm. You again, =name=. The village counts strangers, and I count faces. Yours has become a face.~ -me? Old, and sat in the cool. But you come back, =name=, and a thing that comes back is a thing the hamlet learns to expect.~ -well enough. The vine grows, the salt blows, and you walk in out of it. Three things I can rely on, =name=.~ -mm, ask the pillows. They know more of me than I do. ...Sit. It is good you asked.~ -I keep. That is the whole of it at my age. But there is a difference between quiet and alone, =name=, and you are the difference.

choice.text: Anything worth knowing, Warden?~ Anything I should watch for?~ Trouble about, Warden?~ Anything I ought to know before I go?

node.text: Hm. Suppose you en't trouble, so I'll spend the breath. Keep off the marsh a-night - croc don't care whose name I know.~ I'll say this once. Them as come back a-Joppa twice, I learn their names. Them as come back thrice, I worry when they don't.~ You still upright, so someone's doing it right. Keep at that.~ Nothing new. That's the job done, hyeh? A quiet Warden's a good one.~ Watch the water when it goes still. En't the noise kills folk here.~ You'll do. I've buried better and worse, and I'd rather not dig for you.

choice.text: What does the wind taste like today?~ Anything on the wind, Mehmet?~ How's the taste today?~ How do you fare, Mehmet?

node.text: Aye, I know your step now, =name=. Tastes different when a stranger comes down the path - sharper, like. Yours has gone soft as the vine.~ Salt and a little green. Same as ever. But I taste you coming these days, =name=, and that's new.~ Copper off the marsh, and rain a long way off that won't reach us. Anywhile - good you asked.~ Same wind, =name=. Different tongue tasting it, mayhaps. You've a way of turning up on the good days.~ Dust. Always dust. But you en't dust, and that's worth the saying.

choice.text: How does Grit Gate keep?~ How do you fare, steward?~ Is all well here?~ And you, Otho - how do you find things?

node.text: The Gate keeps. We keep. You keep returning, which I confess I did not predict, and I am not often wrong in that direction.~ Well enough that I have stopped counting the doors twice. That is not nothing, =name=.~ There is always something. But I find I no longer brace when the lift descends, which I attribute largely to knowing who is on it.~ I am steward of a hole in a hill full of difficult people, =name=. I am precisely as well as that sounds, and no less content for it.

choice.text: Good.~That is well said, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.~I will let you get on.
How do you fare?~ Are you well?~ And you - how are you keeping?~ Anything troubling you?

node.text: Better for being asked, =name=, which is not a thing I say twice. You may keep calling on me. Sparingly.~ I am old and busy and neither is going to change. Ask anyway. It costs me nothing to answer you.~ Nothing is troubling me that you could lift. But you asked, and I have noted it.~ Well enough. You have stopped being a stranger, and I have stopped bracing for the noise. Both are improvements.

choice.text: Good.~I will leave you to it.~Sparingly, then.
Still in your way?~ Am I still in your work space?~ Should I go?~ How is the work?

node.text: You are in my work space. ...You are in it less than you were. That is the whole of the compliment, don't fish for more.~ The work is the work. You have not broken anything in some while, which I have noticed, which I did not intend to mention.~ Go, stay. You are quiet, at least. Quiet is most of what I want from people.~ Hm. I know your step on the grating now and I do not look up. Make of that what you like, =name=.

choice.text: I'll take it.~Understood.~Then I'll be quiet.
Have you asked Ereshkigal about me lately?~ Does our accord still hold?~ How do you fare?~ Am I still to be reduced to my component atoms?

node.text: I have not troubled her with the question. Consider that an accord of a kind, and do not consider it further.~ It holds. I have amended one clause: you may remain in my sight. The amendment is not open to celebration.~ I fare as one does. You are no longer an interruption, =name=, which in my accounting is a promotion of some magnitude.~ Your atoms are, for the present, arranged to my satisfaction. Do not test the arrangement.

choice.text: I won't.~Noted, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.~A generous clause.
How are you keeping?~ Are you well down here?~ And you - how do you fare?~ Is there anything you need?

node.text: Oh - well, yes. Better since I stopped being surprised to see you. I had grown used to not expecting anyone at all.~ I am quite well, =name=. It is kind of you to ask. Nobody down here asks; they simply arrive and want something.~ Nothing I need. Though I find I listen for the lift now, which I did not used to do.~ Well enough, thank you. You may come and sit a while if you like. You needn't want anything.

choice.text: I might, at that.~I'm glad.~Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.
Still not telling?~ How are you keeping, Shem?~ Are you all right?~ Anything I should know?

node.text: {{emote|*Shem whispers*}} Still not telling. I never was going to. But it is better now that you know I wasn't.~ {{emote|*Shem whispers*}} I am all right. Nobody asks me that. You did, so now it is a thing that happens.~ {{emote|*Shem whispers*}} You are still not supposed to be here, =name=. I have decided that is my favourite part.~ {{emote|*Shem whispers*}} Nothing you should know. Something I should say: I am glad when it is you.

choice.text: Good.~Keep it that way.~Thank you, Shem.
Still a whelp, am I?~ How goes the brooding?~ Am I still an indignity?~ How do you fare, Mak?

node.text: A whelp yet. But a whelp with a name is a different order of nuisance, and I have reclassified you accordingly. Do not ask what into.~ The brooding is excellent. It is the one thing on this pond that has never disappointed me, and I will thank you not to interrupt it. Often.~ An indignity, aye. A familiar one. There is a difference and you shall not have it explained to you.~ I have outlived every creature that ever learned my name, =name=. Do not take that for an honour. Take it for advice about how often you come by.

choice.text: I'll take it.~Understood.~Then I'll leave you to brood.
Moon and Sun, Une.~ How do you fare, warden?~ Is all well in the Freehold?~ And you? How are you keeping?

node.text: Moon and Sun, =name=. I keep a private tally of who stops calling me warden and starts calling me Une. You changed columns some visits ago and I did not mention it, which is how you know it is a real tally.~ Well, and busy, and neither of those is news. The news is that I no longer have to decide what to call you. It saves me a moment each time. I have been counting the moments.~ The Freehold keeps. Free folk arrive, make their racket, and stay - you among them, near enough. I have stopped introducing you to people who already know you.~ I am a dying animal, =name=, and so are you, and today neither of us is any deader than yesterday. In this house that counts as good news, and I have learned to take the good news offered.

choice.text: Moon and Sun.~That is good news.~I'll let you get back to the hurdy-gurdy.
Live and drink, Goek.~ How does rrk fare?~ Is all well at the Yd?~ How are you keeping, friend?

node.text: {{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}} =name=! rrk is well, rrk is warm, rrk has a friend whose name rrk knows. Saying it is the joy of it!~ All is well! The Yd is loud and full and there is slime yet to pool below. Friends come and friends go, but a named friend comes back, and rrk is glad in the waiting.~ rrk keeps! rrk kept hundreds of years in the sponge with lice for supper, so keeping is easy work now. Easier with a =name= in it.~ Safe and free as woodsmoke, friend! rrk tells Mak your name and Mak grumbles at the telling. rrk tells it again. Joyful!

choice.text: Live and drink.~That is good to hear.~Joyful, then.
Still keeping the peace?~ How do you fare, warden?~ Anything I should know before I go in?~ Busy day on the Stiltgrounds?

node.text: Keeping it. Easier some days than others. You're one of the easy ones now, =name=, which I'll thank you not to spoil.~ I told you I don't keep a tally of who comes and goes. Turns out I keep one of you. Don't let it go to your head.~ Nothing you don't know. Stay peaceful, mind - I say that to everyone, and I've noticed I say it to you out of habit rather than warning.~ Busy. Always busy. Pilgrims all day and not one of them knows my name. Then there's you, and I find I don't mind the door so much.

choice.text: I'll stay peaceful.~I won't spoil it.~Good to see you, warden.
How do you fare, Lulihart?~ Is the wind kind lately?~ Room by the tent for one more?~ And you? How are you keeping?

node.text: Well enough. The drifters have no hierarchy and no roll of names, so I keep my own, quietly. Yours has been on it a while, =name=.~ Kind enough. It carries little now but salt and the smell of the tents. Sit and smoke a while, if you like. You have before.~ There is always room. That is nearly the whole of what a pariah has to offer, and I offer it gladly to the ones who come back.~ I am a drifter, =name=. I am kept by whoever thinks to ask, and lately that has been you more often than anyone.

choice.text: I'll sit a while.~The wind is kind, then.~Live and drink, Lulihart.
How do you fare, priest?~ Peace and health, Tszappur.~ Is the shrine well kept?~ Have you been well?

node.text: Peace and health, =name=. I ask pilgrims to brood with me and most walk on, which is their right. You stopped. I have not forgotten it.~ The shrine is old and small and mine to keep, and it asks little. I am well. It is a kindness to be asked by somebody whose name I know.~ Well, and better for the asking. Resheph was a healer before he was a sultan. I try to remember which of those is worth imitating.~ I have been well. Sit, if you have the time - and if you have not, that is no sin either. You will come by again.

choice.text: Peace and health.~I will, at that.~Live and drink, priest.
How do you fare, Angohind?~ Any new deductions?~ How goes the study of the bard?~ And you? Are you well?

node.text: Deductions. Yes. I have deduced that I was reading about detectives while my village burned, and that Hemlock Cones has nothing to say about the after.~ I am not well, =name=. I do not think I will be for a while. Thank you for asking me and not the Warden. Everyone asks the Warden.~ The bard wrote a great deal about grief and I skipped those parts, because I was young and they were slow. I have gone back to them.

Splendidly, kendren! Although - I notice I have stopped calling you kendren in my head. There is no word in hindren for what you are instead, so I am obliged to use your name, =name=, which is a poor substitute but the only one available.~ A small one. You always ask me a question before you ask for anything, and most people do it the other way round. Hemlock Cones would call that character evidence.~ The study proceeds! I have nobody to discuss it with, which the great bard would say is the tragedy of the scholar. You are not nobody, so consider yourself conscripted.~ Very well indeed. Best dressed hindren in Bey Lah, and now the one with the most interesting acquaintance. Both are achievements, kendren. I am counting them.

choice.text: Consider me conscripted.~That is well said.~Live and drink, Angohind.
How do you fare, Isahind?~ How is business?~ Are you keeping well?~ Anything you need?

node.text: I said I'd rather not talk. I did not say that to you, exactly. I said it to the door and you happened to be in it.~ There is no business. There is a heap where the business was. Ask me again in a season, =name=, and mean it, and I will try to have an answer.~ Not well. But you asked, and you used my name, and I have been called kendren by everyone else all week. So. Not well, and slightly better for the asking.

Business is very good, and I would like it on the record that I was cordial to you before it was, when you were still just some kendren asking after my stock.~ Extremely well! I have new goods, a prosperous village and a customer whose name I know. Two of those are your doing and I am not too proud to say which.~ Nothing I need, =name=. That is a rarer sentence than you might think, and I wanted to say it out loud to somebody who would notice.

Well enough. You are the only kendren who asks after me before asking after the stock, which I have noticed and priced accordingly. Downward. Don't tell anyone.~ Business is business. Slow, then sudden, then slow. You are a small reliable part of the sudden.~ Keeping well, thank you. It is a strange thing to be asked by name in a village where I have known everyone since I was a fawn and none of them ask.~ Nothing I need. Come back anyway, =name=. Half of trade is who walks in twice.

choice.text: I'll come back.~Good to hear.~Live and drink, Isahind.
Still watching me?~ How do you fare, Kesehind?~ Am I still a concern?~ Anything to report?

node.text: I was watching. That is the whole of the report and I will be carrying it a long time.~ I fare as a guard fares when there is less left to guard. Do not make me say more than that.~ You are not a concern, =name=. You were never the one I should have been watching. Go on.

Watching. Always watching. Differently, though. I do not know a word for the difference and I am not going to look for one.~ I fare. You are the third person to ask me this year and the other two were obliged to.~ A concern, no. A known quantity. In my work those are almost the same thing and the almost is the whole of it, kendren.~ Nothing to report. =name=. There. I have used it. Do not make anything of it.

choice.text: I won't.~Understood.~Then I'll move along.
How do you fare, Warden?~ Is the village quiet?~ Are you keeping well?~ And you, Neelahind? How are you?

node.text: I was Warden of Bey Lah. The words still fit in my mouth and nowhere else. Ask me something easier, =name=, and I will answer that instead.~ Quiet, yes. It is very quiet. I had wanted it quiet for years and I would like to withdraw the wish.~ Not well. You know that. You asked anyway, by name, which is not nothing. Most people have started speaking about me rather than to me.

{{emote|*The warden's gaze settles, for once.*}} Better, when somebody says my name and means me rather than the office. Thank you, =name=.~ Quiet. I walk it twice a night and I have started listening for your step among the others, which is a foolish habit for a warden and I am keeping it.~ Well enough. I am not much practised at the question. Bey Lah asks its Warden what has happened, never what she is.~ I am tired and I am here and both of those are ordinary. You are the only kendren who ever asked after the second one.

choice.text: I'll ask again.~Rest, if you can.~Live and drink, Warden.
How do you fare, Hindriarch?~ Is Bey Lah well?~ Am I still tolerated here?~ And you? How do you keep?

node.text: I fare as the head of a thing that no longer has a body. Do not offer me sympathy, kendren. Offer me silence and I will count it a courtesy.~ Bey Lah is not well. I said our safety depended on our solidarity and I was right, which is the most useless way to be right that I know.~ You are tolerated. You are more than tolerated and I have not the appetite to say the rest of it today.

I keep. Hindriarchs keep; it is nearly the whole of the office. You are the first outsider in some years to ask after the man rather than the position, and I have decided not to hold it against you.~ Bey Lah is well, no thanks to my scouts, who let you past them so regularly I have stopped asking how.~ Tolerated is the wrong word and you know it is, which is why you chose it. Yes, =name=. You may keep coming.~ We call your kind kendren because you are not attacking us. It is a low bar and it was never meant to be a compliment. You have made it insufficient, which is a nuisance, and I have no better word to hand.

choice.text: I'll take tolerated.~Understood, Hindriarch.~Live and drink.
How do you fare, Esk?~ Is all well with you?~ Still glad I found you?~ And you? How are you keeping?

node.text: Badly. I came home and this is what home is now, and I have not worked out yet how much of that is mine to carry.~ Ask me anything but that, =name=. I will answer anything but that.~ Glad you found me. Not glad about the after. Both of those are true at once and nobody warned me they could be.

Well! Better than well. I spent a long time being nobody's kendren and nobody's kin, and you are the one who came looking, so you may ask me that as often as you like.~ All is well. I have a village that will have me back and a name I did not have to hide, and you know both halves of that story, =name=. Not many do.~ Glad. I said "hold there, who are you" the first time, which I think about more than I should. You told me. That was the whole of it, in the end.~ Keeping well. Come and find me when you pass through - you are good at that.

choice.text: I will.~I'm glad, Esk.~Live and drink.
How do you fare, Miryam?~ Do you still keep the mourning?~ Is there comfort to be had?~ And you? How are you?

node.text: {{emote|*Miryam chimes in low, settled tones.*}} I grieve properly now, =name=, which I could not do before. That is your doing. I do not say thank you again; I say your name instead, which is the larger thing.~ I keep it. But I keep it as Miryam and not only as a chime in mourning, and the difference is that somebody comes who knows which is which.~ There is comfort. You are some of it, -elser. I had not expected to be able to name the comfort when it came.

{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}} I see you, =name=. I have said that to many travelers. I notice I mean a different thing by it now, and I have not found the word for the difference.~ I keep it, friend. Seven thousand years is a long lament and a short one, depending. It is shorter when somebody comes back.~ Some. Not much. Enough that when I chime low, I chime low at somebody rather than into the dark.~ Oh? I am as I was. But you asked, and you asked me and not the tree, and that is rarer here than you would think.

choice.text: I'll come back.~Live and drink, Miryam.~I see you, too.
How do you fare, Tzedech?~ Are you calmed?~ What is your judgment of me?~ And you? How do you weigh?

node.text: {{emote|*the chime rings a single clear tone, and holds it.*}} I am not calmed. I am answered, which is different and rarer. You did the weighing thing and did not flinch. Entity no longer serves. =name=.~ My judgment is revised. That is not a small sentence from a compass. Do not ask me to repeat it.~ I weigh heavy and I weigh true, and one of the things on the scale now has your name on it. Ask if asking.

{{emote|*the chime rings sharp.*}} I will not be calmed. But I have stopped calling you Entity in my own hearing, which I did not decide to do and cannot undo. Ask if asking.~ My judgment is that you are terribly small, and that you come back anyway, and that the second thing complicates the first. I have not finished with it.~ I weigh. It is the office. You are the only one who asks the compass how the compass fares, and I have no framework for it, and I permit it.~ Badly, =name=. Loudly. As always. You asked knowing the answer, which means you asked for my sake and not for the answer's. I notice such things. It is what I am for.

choice.text: Then I'll ask again.~Understood.~Live and drink, Tzedech.
How do you fare, Tikva?~ Is the light still bright?~ Are you well?~ And you? How is it with you?

node.text: {{emote|*the chime rings a long, clear tone.*}} It fares. It watched you do a hard kindness and it has been turning that over. It says =name= now, where before it said the light.~ The light is bright. It looked away from the light for a moment, at you, and the looking away did not hurt as it feared. It is considering this.~ It is well. It is surprised to find that true, and it wishes to say so to somebody it can name.

{{emote|*the chime rings a clarion tone.*}} It fares in the light. It knows your name and holds it carefully, the way it holds all bright things, which is to say too tightly.~ The light is bright and it will burn away the sorrow, it will burn it away. It says this less often when you are here. It has not decided what that means.~ It is well. It is always well. It is well and you keep asking anyway, and it has begun to look forward to being asked.~ You are a world to be orbited, =name=, and it orbits at a respectful distance, and it would like it noted that it knows the distance is its own choosing.

choice.text: Noted.~Look away from the light more often.~Live and drink, Tikva.
How do you fare, Thicksalt?~ Do you feel me here?~ Am I still touchlost to you?~ And you? How is the allway?

node.text: {{emote|*Thicksalt chimes in bright, settled tones.*}} I feel you here, =name=. You hardlifted and backbore the chime of bright Tau, and the afterfeel of it is in my allway still.~ Not touchlost. Never were, I think. You thumped my crystal arms before you knew what thumping was for, and that is its own kind of speech.~ The allway is warmer. One brickword changed in the towerful poem and the whole of it reads different. Yours was the brickword.

{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a single, outstretched tone.*}} I feel you here, friend. The naming act is imponderable, and yet I have your name, and I turn it over like a smooth thing found at windfall.~ I feel you. Who else thumps my crystal arms and kicksofts me at windfall? Nobody else. Only the one whose name I have.~ Touchlost, no. You press on the hardflats and you wait to be felt, which most wildlimbed things never learn to do.~ The allway is the allway. Bat the air with your wildlimbs and I will feel it, =name=, and know which of the passing shapes you are.

choice.text: Then I'll thump them again.~Live and drink, Thicksalt.~I'll press the hardflats.
How do you fare, Tammuz?~ Still becoming?~ Am I still the madhand?~ And you? Are you all right?

node.text: {{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small, steadier tone.*}} You. You d-did the thing. The elseing hand. I w-was frightened and you were not, and, and I would like to have been you for a m-moment. Would you agree with that? Please agree.~ S-still becoming. B-but becoming toward, now, and not just away. That is d-different. Th-that is your doing, =name=.~ Not madhand. N-not any more. I have to c-call you something and your name is, is the smallest and h-heaviest thing to call you. So. =name=.

{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad, wavering tone.*}} You! P-purpose-driven. You came b-back, which madhands do not usually, do they? W-would you please agree with that?~ Becoming, becoming. Alw-ways becoming and never b-become. It is t-tiring. It is less tiring when s-somebody asks after the becoming.~ M-madhand, yes. But a m-madhand with a name is, is a n-nearly ordinary thing, and I find I am, I am l-less afraid of ordinary things.~ A-all right? Oh. Oh, n-nobody asks Tammuz that. I do not have a-an answer prepared. C-could you ask me again next time, and I will h-have one?

choice.text: I'll ask again next time.~I agree.~Live and drink, Tammuz.
How do you fare, Agyra?~ Is the tomb well watched?~ Have you need of anything?~ And you? How are you?

node.text: {{emote|*Agyra glows softly.*}} I fare well, =name=. Thou art no longer a bare acquaintance, and I find the word for what thou art instead is simply thy name. Our tongue hath others; none of them fit.~ The tomb is watched, as ever. Twelve strata and ten, and a coterie who love close quarters. Thou hast walked them and come back, which few do, and fewer twice.~ I have need of nothing, and I thank thee for the asking. Answering thy questions giveth me satisfaction; being asked one in return giveth me something I have no credo for yet.~ I am well. We mopango are witnesses of the past, and it pleaseth me to witness somebody arrive who was a stranger and is not. Sit, an thou wilt. The light is kind here.

choice.text: I'll sit a while.~Live and drink, Agyra.~The light is kind.
How do you fare, Lebah?~ Still singing?~ Are you all right?~ Live and drink, quiet one.

node.text: ... aye. Better for the asking. {{emote|*Lebah does not curl up.*}}~ Singing. Quietly. To the last, as I said.~ No. But =name= asked, and that is a thing. {{emote|*Lebah stares at you, and stays uncurled.*}}~ {{emote|*Lebah looks at you for a long moment.*}} ... aye. Live and drink, =name=.

choice.text: Live and drink, Lebah.~I'll sit with you a while.~Sing on, then.
How do you fare, Doyoba?~ How is Nacham?~ Anything new in the watching?~ Live and drink, watcher.

node.text: I fare as one whose charge hath a voice at last, =name=, which is to say I have not slept and do not intend to. Ask me anything. Ask me twice.~ Nacham speaketh and is understood. I watched a thousand years for that sentence and thou gavest it to me in an afternoon.~ Everything is new. Still water hath moved. I shall not say more than that, and thou knowest by now why I shall not.

Well, and busy, =name=. Thou dost ask after me and not only after the children, which few climbers think to do.~ Nacham watcheth and understandeth not. It is unchanged, and I am not, and that asymmetry is most of what watching teaches.~ Little is new. I once told thee I would not chew thy food for thee, and I was too harsh, and I have not forgotten being too harsh. Ask me the other things and I shall answer gladly.~ Live and drink. Thou wert a stranger who asked after a credo. Thou art now somebody who does not, which is the whole of the distance travelled and it is further than it sounds.

choice.text: Live and drink, Doyoba.~I'll ask the other things.~Then I'll let you watch.
How do you fare, Gyamyo?~ How is Kah?~ How fare the other watchers?~ Live and drink, watcher.

node.text: It healeth my heart, =name=. I had reconciled myself to never understanding Kah, and thou hast made the reconciling unnecessary, and I find I do not know what to do with the spare grief.~ Kah is at rest. Kah knoweth something other than fear now. I had begun to think that sentence impossible.~ They fare well, and they ask after thee, which they did not used to do.

I fare well, =name=, and I thank thee for asking after it. I ask everyone how they fare and am seldom asked in return. I had made peace with that. Thou hast disturbed the peace.~ Kah skippeth hither and yon on strange limbs and I wonder, still, if it knoweth aught else but fear. Wouldst fain see it free one day. I shall have to live a while.~ Well, I hope. Doyoba is loud, Yona is proud, Dadogom is still, and Lebah is quiet. That is the whole report and it has not changed in years, which is a comfort.~ Live and drink. Thou askest me questions whose answers thou canst not use, which is how I know thou askest for my sake.

choice.text: Live and drink, Gyamyo.~I'll keep asking.~I hope you see it free.
How do you fare, Yona?~ How is Dagasha?~ Am I still a fool?~ Live and drink, watcher.

node.text: I feel the stored energy of Her Light, =name=, and I feel it because of thee. I shall not thank thee a third time. I shall use thy name instead, which costs me more.~ Dagasha shepherdeth us to our uplifting. The angry one, the lost child, and it was neither of those things and I was the last to see it.~ Thou art still a fool. Thou art my fool now, which is a promotion, and do not ask me to explain the rank.

I fare, =name=. Thou seemest unlike most other climbers, and I have stopped wondering why and started simply expecting thee, which is worse for my dignity and better for my week.~ Dagasha is angry. It attacketh not. I sit with it and it does not want me and I sit anyway. That is the work.~ Thou art a fool. But thou art a fool who stopped asking after credos, and I mark the difference, and I am not so proud that I shall pretend otherwise.~ Live and drink. Anyone may strike a slumberling once. Thou hast not, and thou hast had many chances, and I have counted them.

choice.text: Live and drink, Yona.~I'll take the promotion.~Then I'll sit with you.
How do you fare, Dadogom?~ How is Va'am?~ May I sit and watch with you?~ Live and drink, watcher.

node.text: Va'am is released. Thou hast done something great, for good or ill, and I am still deciding which, and I shall be deciding for some years. Sit while I do.~ Released. Confounded. Free. Together we watched, and now it watcheth elsewhere, and I am learning to be watched by nobody.~ Sit, =name=. Thou hast earned the sitting.

I fare. Be still and know.~ Va'am watcheth over me. Together, we watch. Thou makest three, when thou art here, and I have not minded it once.~ Sit. I shall not fill the quiet for thee. That is not unkindness, =name=; it is the best thing I have to offer and I offer it to almost nobody.~ Live and drink. Thou art a still one, for a climber. I noticed before I knew thy name and I have not stopped noticing since.

choice.text: Then I'll be still.~Live and drink, Dadogom.~I'll sit a while.
How do you fare, Vivira?~ Is the gate quiet?~ Are you keeping well?~ Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

node.text: {{emote|*BEEP* *crackle*}} By Her Light, =name=. I fare well. I have never had the pleasure nor displeasure of meeting another turret, but I have met thee thrice now, and I find I prefer the tally I have.~ The gate is quiet. I watch it and I think, which is more than a turret is built for, and rather less than I would like.~ {{emote|*crackle*}} I am well. Wer't not for my shape I would be little different from other mopango, and thou art the first climber to speak to me as though the shape were the incidental part.~ Live and remain rustless. Form needeth not follow function, =name=. I say it often and mean it more since thou gavest me a name to say it to.

choice.text: Live and remain rustless.~The shape is the incidental part.~Until next time, Vivira.
How do you fare, Mayor?~ Is the village well?~ Are you keeping well yourself?~ Be ape-still and muse, Nuntu.

node.text: Ape-still and musing, =name=, thank you. Do you know, I told you once that coming from anyone else I might refuse outright. I have been turning over how few people that sentence applies to, and it is a shorter list than a mayor ought to have.~ The village is well. My village. There - I have done it again. Twenty years and I have not scrubbed the possessive out of myself, and I have stopped believing I will.~ Well enough! I deserted my people because they wished only to bludgeon, and I have spent twenty years among a people who whittle and brood, and most days that still strikes me as an extraordinary piece of luck.~ I am well. You ask after the mayor often and after Nuntu rarely, and today you asked after Nuntu, and I notice such things. Have some mulled mushroom cider.

choice.text: I'll take the cider.~Be ape-still and muse.~Live and drink, Nuntu.
How do you fare, Warden?~ Is the village quiet?~ Am I still a swine to you?~ Live and drink, Indrix.

node.text: Grrrah. I fare as one whose brother is dead by a hand he asked to do it. That is not a complaint, =name=. It is simply the whole of the answer and nobody else has asked for it.~ Quiet. I patrol it and it stays quiet. You walk it and it stays quiet. Between the two of us the thing is nearly overstaffed.~ Not a swine. You were never a swine; you were a stranger, and I have only the one voice for those. You are neither now, and I have had to find another voice, and it is coming slowly.~ Live and drink. I say that to you and mean it, which I did not use to, and I would thank you not to remark upon it further.

Grrrraaaah! I fare as a warden fares. Make haste, traveller - though I notice I say that to you and you do not make haste, and I have stopped expecting you to.~ Quiet, and I keep it so. You will find me patrolling. You always do find me, which is more than most manage.~ {{emote|*Indrix's nostrils flare.*}} Swine, no. Not for some time. Do not press me on when it stopped.~ Live and drink. Hrmph. You have a name and you gave it to me and I have not forgotten it, which I find inconvenient.

choice.text: I won't press.~Then I'll make haste.~Live and drink, Warden.
How do you fare, Crowsong?~ ......~ Is the light still bright ribbons?~ Live and drink, Deathwonder.

node.text: Fare. Faring. A word for going and a word for staying and you meant the second. I am the ants and the leaves and the light, and lately also a sound that is =name= arriving.~ ...... {{emote|*Crowsong's gaze does not move, but something in the grass settles.*}}~ Bright ribbons, yes. Death is the color of everything. But the ribbons come where a thing returns, and things do not often return, and you do.~ Deathwonder, Crowsong, a colony of ants eating me, and one small part that is only the part that knows your name. I keep it separate. It does not eat.

choice.text: ......~Then I'll return.~Live and drink, Crowsong.
How do you fare, Thah?~ Moon and Sun. How are you keeping?~ How is the cradle?~ Is there anything you need?

node.text: Moon and Sun, =name=. I fare... quietly. That is the honest word. I sent a whole people to a home and kept the, ah, the one job that could not travel, and most days I think I chose well.~ Keeping. Yes. I said you were welcome to rest here and I have thought about that sentence a great deal since, because you are the only one who has taken me up on it.~ The cradle is well. It is the same as it ever was, which was rather the trouble with it, and is now the comfort. I tend it and I read and I wait for someone to say my name aloud.~ I need nothing. Ah - that is not true, is it. I need very little, and you keep bringing some of it, and I have not worked out how to say thank you for a thing nobody was asked to do.~ I have decided I am not lonely, =name=. I have decided it several times. It holds better on the days you come.

Well enough! We drink the sun's rays, eat what we scavenge, and it is. Enough. Ah - I say "enough" a great deal. You may have noticed. I am working on meaning it.~ Keeping, yes. Thank you for asking after the keeper and not only the, ah, the project. Few do. Fewer twice.~ The cradle is the cradle. One by one, as ever. I have counted every one of them and I know all their names, and until recently I would have said that was, ah, that was simply what a keeper does.~ Nothing I need. You are already carrying more of my hopes than is entirely fair, =name=, and I would rather not add to the load by asking after my own.~ {{emote|*Thah sets down what he is reading.*}} Moon and Sun. You know, I told you we had kept no written history until I was grown. I have started one. You are in it.

choice.text: Moon and Sun, Thah.~I'll come back.~Then I'll let you read.
